answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the terrace of a task receipt, and the horizon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. The hollow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
